intro: Chemical Engineering (Hons.) student at BITS Pilani Goa with a minor in Finance. I build AI/ML systems end to end — from flood early-warning for Assam and explainable retinopathy screening to quant research and the AI career OS that writes my resume.

casualWorks.title: Reinforcement Learning Lab
casualWorks.description: Multi-armed bandits (epsilon-greedy, optimistic initial values, UCB), MDPs and the Bellman equation, then training and evaluating an agent with Stable-Baselines3 on Gym.

casualWorks.title: Neural Networks from Scratch
casualWorks.description: An MNIST network and backpropagation written in NumPy, then CNNs on CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST with TensorFlow/Keras.

casualWorks.title: Linear Regression from Scratch, Animated
casualWorks.description: Gradient-descent linear regression implemented by hand and animated step by step, checked against scikit-learn.

casualWorks.title: COVID-19 India: State-wise Analysis
casualWorks.description: Exploratory analysis of case growth, recovery vs. death rates and state-wise impact across India.

casualWorks.title: Analytics Case Studies: HR Attrition & US Honey
casualWorks.description: Two EDA case studies: why employees leave (experience, project load) with retention suggestions, and US honey production trends by state and year.

casualWorks.title: Web Scraping with Python
casualWorks.description: Scraping pages with requests and BeautifulSoup into Pandas tables, including checking robots.txt first.
